node.title: Re^2: Removing empty line(s) with regex in a multiple strings in a variable
node.author: JD
node.doctext: This expression has been very useful but I am new to Perl and regex and I would like to fully understand the process of how this works. Would it be possible to ask if it can be broken down step by step. I am afraid I just find the capture groups and newline characters somewhat confusing.
